messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.35-1
parts:
A new version of R/qtl (1.35-1) has been released at its web site
(http://www.rqtl.org) and soon to appear on CRAN.

This fixes a small but important bug in summary.cross that can also
show up in read.cross.

Karl Broman
